attempts.summary: Configured node1 with an authenticated SMB share named projects. Node2 can list, read, create, and update documents as designer. Guest, anonymous, sibling-share, and parent-traversal access are rejected. Original drawings remain checksum-identical. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and recovered with changed boot identities. CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 were retained.
